ef1a9ebb69fd.visual: A cream-coloured stone building with tall windows and prominent classical columns. A sculptured head sits above the roof line, and ornamental balustrades run along the parapet.

ef52bcf59325.visual: Red-brick and stone library of two storeys: dark brick below, lighter stone above. Three sash windows face the upper storey; further windows punctuate the lower level. Stone columns and steps frame a recessed entrance on the right.

ef88c0da01c3.visual: Two-storey pink-brick building with columned entrance vestibule and tall windows. Green foliage climbs the stone wall to the right; clear sky above.

ef951513de42.visual: Red-brick two-storey building with slate roof, white-trimmed windows, and a raised entrance with wooden steps. Bare deciduous trees and clear blue sky frame the structure.

efa7a147162c.visual: Red-brick building with hipped roof and decorative eaves. A central entrance is reached by stone steps and flanked by large multi-pane windows. A sign is mounted on the lower facade. Bare trees, patchy snow and a yellow fire hydrant surround it.

efb7999ac091.visual: Red brick building with hipped roof, dormer windows, and four large windows with arched tops. White entrance door flanked by evergreen shrubs, with bare trees framing the grass forecourt.

efbbf8d70a97.visual: Classical stone building with four tall columns and a decorated roof. Text is carved above the entrance, which is reached by steps with a railing. Ivy hangs at the corners.

efe8a60c0865.visual: Two-storey red brick building with white columns flanking a central arched entrance beneath a pitched roof. Tall windows line the facade; climbing ivy covers both side walls. A paved forecourt with metal railings leads to the entrance.

f04d5035212a.visual: Red brick building with stone trim and traditional windows, joined by a modern glass extension with metal railings. Bare trees and pale sky frame the structure.

f08362fddfa7.visual: A symmetrical stone building with cream facade and red hip roof, featuring a columned central entrance and arched doorway. Approached by wide steps through landscaped grounds under clear sky.

f0b714194e0b.visual: A single-storey brick and stone building with a classical entrance portico and white columns. Bare winter trees stand before the façade; green lawn and hedges border the grounds.

f1dd3b81bcfc.visual: A two-storey stone building with a raised central entrance and wide arched windows across its front facade. Trees frame the entrance steps, and the right side features rectangular windows across its lower level.

f1f801da9b8e.visual: A single-storey cream-coloured building heavily covered in dark green ivy on its left side and roof. A bay window and Union Jack flagpole are visible, surrounded by mature trees and lawn.

f215d06214a3.visual: Red brick building with an arched gable window and white-framed entrance, terracotta roof tiles visible. Dense green ivy covers the right façade and much of the front, with a large tree at the corner.

f24ce7dcadb0.visual: Brick library building with two semicircular windows in gabled roof, central entrance, and perimeter wall with red bollards. Surrounded by mature trees, under clear sky.

f26fac6e78aa.visual: A two-storey brick building with large rectangular windows in regular rows and a distinctive peaked roof element, set among bare trees and open lawns.

f3921fbc5ff8.visual: Red brick library with rendered base, arched entrance beneath a gabled pediment, and tall windows with green frames. Ivy clings to the right side; clear sky above.

f3fcb22b2e93.visual: Red brick building with peaked roof and arched windows, surrounded by mature deciduous trees with lawn and gravel driveway, under partly cloudy skies.

f4f2e207b57e.visual: Stone-built library with a central tower topped by a domed roof and weathervane. Classical columned entrance with large arched windows on either side; red flowers bloom across the front.

f53ade555e5b.visual: Single-storey cream-rendered building with three arched windows, a central dark door and wall lamps. Dense green hedging obscures the base of the facade.

f54e443c0ebc.visual: A two-storey building clad in red wooden shingles with a pitched grey roof and painted signage on its gable. A dark red entrance door tops wooden steps with railings; a stone marker stands in the yard amid bare trees.

f60301e0c7ca.visual: A two-storey brick library with cream-coloured stone trim and "PUBLIC LIBRARY" inscribed on the upper frieze. Four tall windows frame a columned central entrance; bare trees stand either side under clear blue sky.

f6fddc8faee6.visual: Two-storey brick building with stone trim, featuring fluted columns flanking the entrance and a pediment with carved lettering. Low planting beds frame the entrance steps.

f74c0b071793.visual: Cream brick building with a flat roof and dark horizontal trim. Three large windows are sheltered by red fabric awnings; metal-railed steps lead to a raised entrance above a blue-grey stone or concrete base.

f7d0a0675ec5.visual: A two-storey stone building with a hip roof and three tall arched windows on the upper facade. A plaque is mounted between the windows; vehicles are parked in front under clear blue sky.

f84fb3c6bee8.visual: Cream-coloured building with classical symmetrical facade, triangular pediment, and red-tiled roof. Tall windows frame a central entrance accessed by broad steps, with mature trees flanking the building against clear sky.

f8c55bd92881.visual: Symmetrical stone classical building with three tall arched windows in turquoise frames with vertical glazing bars, a central dark entrance door, and smaller windows below. Low parapet roof and ornate stonework; landscaped forecourt with steps and planters.

f8c8a461348a.visual: A two-storey building: white-painted brick upper storey with arched windows in pale yellow trim, red brick lower storey with arched openings. Dried evergreen shrubs stand in front beneath grey sky.

f903a93d9ce2.visual: Red brick building with an arched entrance and tall rectangular windows. Climbing ivy covers the right wall. A chimney rises from the hipped roof. Metal bicycle racks stand in the forecourt.

f9ee3825c5e5.visual: Red brick classical building with tall white columns flanking wooden doors, beneath a triangular pediment. Concrete steps with a central metal rail lead to the entrance; trees and shrubs surround the facade on a clear day.

fa243971dd1b.visual: A brick building with a hipped roof and central white-columned entrance portico on a raised plinth. Arched windows are symmetrically arranged across the facade. Bare ground and leafless trees surround it.

fa4ecfd60c9b.visual: Symmetrical red brick building with cream stone trim, two storeys, and a pitched gable roof. Central red double doors sit atop raised steps behind a metal railing; tall multi-paned windows flank the entrance.

fa587d22e173.visual: Single-storey brick building with steeply pitched green roof and cream-timber gable entrance. Ivy densely covers the left wall; multi-pane windows flank the wooden doors. A blue postal box stands on the forecourt under clear sky.

fa61848404b0.visual: A two-storey stone building with red-tiled roof and deep eaves. Four tall windows above a white door flanked by two windows below, decorated with black swag garland and a wreath. Climbing ivy covers part of the exterior.

fa88976156f3.visual: Red-brick building with a white-columned entrance portico, blue doors and windows, clipped hedges in front, power lines overhead against clear blue sky.

fb53b623f690.visual: A brick library with classical stone pediment and finials, columns surrounding an arched entrance, and tall rectangular windows on either side. Steps between low hedges ascend to dark-painted doors beneath carved stone text.

fb6090b11b75.visual: A single-storey red-brick building sits raised on a masonry base, with large windows and a broad hipped roof. Concrete steps lead to the entrance; a leafless tree stands in front against blue sky.

fb709ce52579.visual: Red brick building with pitched tiled roof and symmetrical facade. Stone-trimmed arched entrance with double doors flanked by paired sash windows; circular window above. Bordered by shrubs and concrete path.

fbdb57ec27e9.visual: A stone building with a peaked roof above the centre and tall columns flanking the entrance. Two white lanterns stand before shrubs and manicured lawn beneath a clear sky.

fbf673f71603.visual: A single-storey red brick library building with a central portico reading "PUBLIC LIBRARY" flanked by deep red ornamental shrubs. Concrete steps lead to double doors, with a lawn and walkway in front under overcast sky.

fc1701364ea7.visual: A two-storey stone building with raised central entrance flanked by columns and topped with ornate carved lettering. Tall windows line both storeys; overgrown grass covers the foreground beneath a clear blue sky.

fc2adc082641.visual: Red brick building with large arched windows topped by semicircular fan lights. A central arched doorway sits beneath a triangular pediment, with an American flag on a pole in front and dense green foliage surrounding the structure.

fc8beac89052.visual: Single-storey stone building with pale walls, dark brick pilasters, tall sash windows, stepped entrance with white railings, and carved inscription. Decorative roof cornice; red brick building adjacent.

fc9b5f50c29d.visual: A red brick building with tall arched windows set in pale stone surrounds, topped by a domed roof weathered green and grey. Brick salvage is stacked in the overgrown forecourt.

fca68bee2ee1.visual: A red brick building with a stone base and large arched windows, set back behind mature trees and a grass verge. Steps lead up to a central entrance.

fcd672443e2f.visual: Pale stone building with fluted columns at a street corner, featuring a large arched window on the curved facade. Mature trees flank either side; a parked car sits in front under partly cloudy sky.

fd5ad8b8630c.visual: Single-storey timber-clad building with pitched dark-tiled roof and gabled sections. Arched window on left, rectangular windows, landscaped shrubs with climbing ivy on the right, paved forecourt, yellow kerbline, overcast sky.

fd7cac91111c.visual: A brick building with a classical white stone front, two columns supporting a pediment inscribed "Public Library". The entrance door sits beneath an arched window, framed by green trees.

fe8b17e1c9ba.visual: Red brick building with pitched roof, tall windows and a modern glass extension on the right. Ivy clothes the left wall; hedging and mature trees frame the landscaped setting.

feced9f02a71.visual: Pale cream-coloured building with classical portico: four tall white columns support a triangular pediment above wide entrance steps with handrails. Pink flowering shrubs and ornamental grasses frame the foundation; clear blue sky above.

fedd327a16a6.visual: Cream-coloured stone building with a classical entrance portico and tall columns supporting a wide pediment. Steps with blue railings lead to a round globe light above the doorway, surrounded by mature trees against clear blue sky.

ff161e2a1c93.visual: Stone building with rounded arched windows on the upper storey and smaller windows below, dark pitched roof, bare winter trees in front, cars parked at the kerb.

ff7f1841c601.visual: A single-storey red-brick building topped with a domed cupola. White columns frame the classical portico entrance; tall windows line the façade with ivy covering the flanks.
